body:
English:
# Apple Server  

## Introduction  
This server is based on **Minecraft 1.21.1 Neoforge**, with core gameplay centered around **Create Mod** and **railway systems**, while retaining the freedom of vanilla survival.  
The server is deeply customized from the [Mechanomania](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/mechanomania) modpack, with additional mods and custom recipes to make gameplay even richer and more diverse.  

## Hardware Specifications  
- **CPU**: Intel Xeon Platinum 8470Q, 4 allocated cores, CPU-Z single-core score 550  
- **Memory**: 16 GB high-performance RAM  
- **Expected Concurrent Players**: Smooth operation for up to 60 players  

## Server Features  
- **Overworld mob spawn rate reduced from 70 to 10**: The extremely low spawn rate allows you to build machines with peace of mind, without frequent monster interruptions.  
- **Challenging Outer End Islands**: If you're looking for combat thrills, monsters on the Outer End Islands have been significantly enhanced—perfect for team challenges.  
- **Railway-Themed Map**: The railway  is  by the [YouTube channel 菱源Y](https://www.youtube.com/), featuring beautiful railway schematics for viewing and use.  
- **Spawn Portal**: A fully-framed End portal awaits at coordinates (0,0), making it easy for players to quickly access the End.  

## Recommended Playstyles  
- Create Mod machinery construction  
- Vanilla survival and architectural creativity  
- Railway system appreciation and expansion  
- Exploration and combat (Outer End Islands)  
- *More playstyles waiting for you to discover!*  

## Contact

Welcome to join us in building our world of railways and machinery!

中文：
# 苹果服务器

## 简介
本服务器以 **Minecraft 1.21.1 Neoforge** 为基础，核心玩法围绕**机械动力**与**铁路系统**展开，同时保留原版生存的自由体验。  
服务器基于 [Mechanomania](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/mechanomania) 整合包进行深度定制，新增了多个模组及自定义配方，玩法更加丰富多样。

## 硬件配置
- **CPU**：Intel Xeon Platinum 8470Q ，4 核分配，CPU-Z 单核跑分 550  
- **内存**：16 GB 内存  
- **预计同时在线人数**：50 人流畅运行

## 服务器特色
- **主世界怪物生成率从70下调至10**：极低的刷怪量让你安心建造机器，不必频繁受到怪物干扰。  
- **末地外岛高难挑战**：若想体验战斗乐趣，末地外岛的怪物经过特别强化，适合玩家组队挑战。  
- **铁路主题地图**：铁路系统来源于 [YouTube 频道 菱源Y](https://www.youtube.com/)，提供精美的铁路存档供观赏与使用。  
- **出生点传送门**：坐标 (0,0) 处设有一座满眼的末地门，方便玩家快速进入末地。

## 玩法推荐
- 机械动力机器建造  
- 原版生存与建筑创作  
- 铁路系统观赏与扩展  
- 探索与战斗（末地外岛）  
- *更多玩法等你来探索！*

## 联系方式
- **QQ 群**：727291968  
- **邮箱**：3903453593@qq.com  

欢迎加入，一起创造属于我们的铁路与机械世界！
